exposure: Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra virgin olive oil (EVOO) and pistachios
Standard diet with limited fat intake
outcome: Small and large for gestational age (SGA and LGA)
Admissions to neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Early intervention with a supplemented Mediterranean diet reduced the incidence of GDM and improved several maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to a standard diet.
mod_finding: IG had also significantly reduced rates of insulin-treated GDM, prematurity,  emergency CS,  perineal trauma, and SGA and LGA newborns (all p<0.05).
gest_age: 8-12 weeks at baseline, outcomes assessed at 24-28 weeks and birth
